resources.title: [OSRS] Dragon Slayer 2 quest guide
resources.creator: Slayermusiq1
resources.noteEs: Walkthrough completo de Dragon Slayer II, la quest grandmaster que desbloquea la Myths' Cape y mejoras clave. Slayermusiq1 es la referencia canónica para guías de quests en OSRS.
resources.noteEn: A full walkthrough of Dragon Slayer II, the grandmaster quest that unlocks the Myths' Cape and key upgrades. Slayermusiq1 is the canonical reference for OSRS quest guides.

resources.title: OSRS - Song of the Elves Quest Guide
resources.creator: GoingCrazy201
resources.noteEs: Guía paso a paso de Song of the Elves, la quest final de la serie élfica que desbloquea Prifddinas. Detallada de principio a fin, ideal para no perderse en sus puzzles.
resources.noteEn: A step-by-step guide to Song of the Elves, the final quest in the elf series that unlocks Prifddinas. Detailed from start to finish, ideal for not getting lost in its puzzles.

resources.title: Updated Monkey Madness 2 quest guide
resources.creator: Slayermusiq1
resources.noteEs: Guía actualizada de Monkey Madness II, quest grandmaster que desbloquea Kruk's Dungeon y el royal seed pod. Versión reciente con los cambios más nuevos incorporados.
resources.noteEn: An updated guide to Monkey Madness II, the grandmaster quest that unlocks Kruk's Dungeon and the royal seed pod. A recent version with the latest changes folded in.

resources.title: [OSRS HD Quest Guide] Monkey Madness 1
resources.creator: Timaeus OSRS
resources.noteEs: Guía en HD de Monkey Madness I, requisito para varias quests posteriores y desbloqueo de la dragon scimitar. Producción clara con timestamps para seguir cada sección.
resources.noteEn: An HD guide to Monkey Madness I, a requirement for several later quests and the unlock for the dragon scimitar. Clean production with timestamps to follow each section.

resources.title: [OSRS HD Quest Guide] Recipe For Disaster: The Final Battle
resources.creator: Timaeus OSRS
resources.noteEs: Guía de la batalla final de Recipe for Disaster contra el Culinaromancer, una de las quests más recompensadas del juego (desbloquea los Barrows gloves). Enfocada en superar el combate.
resources.noteEn: A guide to the Recipe for Disaster final battle against the Culinaromancer, one of the most rewarding quests in the game (it unlocks the Barrows gloves). Focused on beating the fight.
